subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When the lock approval is requested, the system shall present every requirement change made during the draft together with its ruling, marking each change that no ruling names.
rationale: The lock review shows who changed what and why (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-9)
fit_criterion: The approval request of a fixture draft with five ruled changes and one unruled change lists all six, the five with author, reason, and triggering problem and the sixth marked unruled.
